items.source:
Opaque object used to hold transaction information. Subclasses
must pass it back to methods on this class, but not see its internals.
items.translation: 不透明对象，用于保存事务信息。子类必须将其返回给本类的各个方法，但不得访问其内部结构。

items.source:
Return a String representation of this joinpoint (usually a Method call)
for use in logging.
items.translation: 返回此连接点（通常是方法调用）的字符串表示形式，以便用于日志记录。

items.source:
Return whether a transaction was created by this aspect,
or whether we just have a placeholder to keep ThreadLocal stack integrity.
items.translation: 返回事务是否由该切面创建，或者我们是否仅拥有一个占位符以保持 ThreadLocal 栈的完整性。

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
